title: rtl-design result.json contract
description: Complete contract for <module>/Design/rtl-design/result.json. stage_specific has no pass-required fields; on status=fail it requires fail_reason (if/then below), the one-line failure narrative, and may name fix_owner. The stage's substance is handed off through its promoted sidecars and its per-child intent reviews, not through this envelope, and TOP is not restated here: it is manifest.module, which every consumer declares as an input.

fix_owner.description: Repair stage supported by the evidence: this stage or a transitive input producer, checked by the scheduler. Omit when attribution is unresolved.
